definitions.gloss: gastritis; inflammation of the stomach lining
definitions.explanation: A medical condition in which the lining of the stomach becomes inflamed, causing symptoms such as stomach pain, nausea, and discomfort.

examples.japanese: {胃炎|いえん}と{診断|しんだん}された。
ストレスで{胃炎|いえん}になった。
{慢性的|まんせいてき}な{胃炎|いえん}に{悩|なや}まされていたが、{食生活|しょくせいかつ}を{見直|みなお}したら{改善|かいぜん}した。
examples.english: I had been suffering from chronic gastritis, but it improved after I reviewed my eating habits.

notes:
A compound of {胃|い} (stomach) and {炎|えん} (inflammation). The {炎|えん} suffix is productive in medical terminology: {肺炎|はいえん} (pneumonia), {腸炎|ちょうえん} (enteritis), {肝炎|かんえん} (hepatitis), etc. Knowing this pattern helps learners decode many medical terms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急性|きゅうせい}{胃炎|いえん}: acute gastritis
- {慢性|まんせい}{胃炎|いえん}: chronic gastritis
- {胃炎|いえん}の{薬|くすり}: gastritis medication
- {胃炎|いえん}になる: to develop gastritis
- {萎縮性|いしゅくせい}{胃炎|いえん}: atrophic gastritis

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {胃潰瘍|いかいよう}: stomach ulcer — more severe than {胃炎|いえん}; involves damage to the stomach lining
- {胃痛|いつう}: stomachache — a symptom rather than a diagnosis
- {胃腸炎|いちょうえん}: gastroenteritis — inflammation of both the stomach and intestines
